55341.x: A home network now carries far more than a laptop or two, with streams, cameras, assistants and a growing crowd of smart devices all competing for the air. Keeping a game's connection stable in that crowd is the test.
ASUS Computer International was named a 2027 Honoree in Gaming & eSports at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the ROG Rapture GT-BN98 Pro.

The description calls it the world's first consumer WiFi 8 router, built for high-performance gaming, dense smart-home networks and emerging AI-era applications. Its quad-band WiFi 8 architecture delivers up to 30Gbps total wireless throughput and supports mechanisms that improve mid-range throughput, uplink reliability, IoT coverage, spectrum efficiency and multi-device coordination, for low-latency gaming, 4K/8K streaming, cloud services and connected-home systems.

The router also features dual 10G Ethernet ports, including one optimized for gaming, four 2.5G Ethernet ports and eight external antennas, with a custom thermal structure, semi-transparent design and Aura RGB lighting.
ASUSWRT 6.0, WiFi Insight, Adaptive QoE and GTNet enhance network visibility, bandwidth allocation and gaming route optimization.

55342.x: Handheld PCs promise console-grade play in the hands, but the screen, the controls and the heat are where that promise usually breaks. Fitting it all into something comfortable to hold is the hard part.
ASUS Computer International was named a 2027 Honoree in Gaming & eSports at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the ROG XBOX Ally X20.

The Windows 11 handheld features a 7.4-inch OLED panel with 1400-nit peak brightness in HDR, a 120Hz refresh rate, a 0.2ms response time and FreeSync Premium Pro. Powered by the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme processor with 50 TOPS of NPU power, its Auto SR AI technology, the description says, delivers 1440p-level detail from a native 720p render whenever an external display is used.

The control architecture is overhauled with TMR joysticks to eliminate mechanical drift and a Transforming D-pad that toggles between four-way and eight-way inputs, along with flush-fitting domed ABXY buttons, reshaped bumpers and impulse triggers with deeper travel.
To sustain peak processing, the evolved internal cooling system uses a direct air channel and high-flow fans to prevent thermal throttling.

55343.x: A phone propped on a desk holds a lot of someone's working day, but it just sits there, waiting to be picked up. Giving it a body that reacts and a sense of what is on screen turns it into something that leans in.
Beijing Keyi Technology Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Mobile Devices, Accessories & Apps at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Loona Deskmate.
Loona Deskmate introduces a new category of embodied AI by turning an iPhone into a screen-aware robotic companion for work and everyday productivity.

Unlike standalone AI devices, Deskmate extends the smartphone experience through expressive robotics, contextual intelligence and mobile computing. Powered by the user's iPhone, it understands on-screen content, provides proactive assistance and interacts through voice and physical expression while connecting with everyday tools such as email, calendars, messages and documents.
By bringing AI into the physical world, Deskmate creates a more natural, intuitive and engaging way for people to interact with technology.

Beijing Zhengqi Future Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for QUORRA X5, an AI-powered intelligent mobility platform.

The description calls QUORRA X5 an AI-powered intelligent mobility platform designed to redefine personal independence through autonomous accessibility. Rather than functioning solely as a mobility aid, it combines autonomous driving, intelligent perception, robotic assistance and human-centered interaction into one system meant to help users move freely, safely and confidently in everyday environments.

Built on a software-defined architecture, X5 continuously understands its surroundings, assists users throughout the journey and adapts to changing environments through AI-driven perception and decision-making, integrating intelligent navigation, obstacle avoidance, autonomous following, remote operation and robotic interaction.

The description positions it as a new generation of intelligent assistive technology meant to enhance dignity, independence and quality of life, expanding human capability rather than simply compensating for physical limitations.

Belkin International was named a 2027 Honoree in Mobile Devices, Accessories & Apps at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Titan SmartShield Pro Bright Privacy Screen Protector.

The two-way privacy protector is designed to reduce the brightness loss usually associated with privacy glass. Its optical construction limits viewing from side angles while, the description says, letting the display stay more than 10 percent brighter than conventional privacy screen protectors.
That can let users run the device at a lower brightness setting, which the description says helps reduce display-related power consumption.

Bright Privacy also adds anti-reflective technology for clarity and visibility, along with impact and scratch protection, combining visual privacy, optical performance and physical screen protection in a single accessory.

DAMGARA Co., Ltd., NEXTEP studio Co., Ltd. and Gachon University were named a 2027 Honoree in Art Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for SCAPESYNC, a data-responsive interactive media facade.

SCAPESYNC turns visitor photos into site-specific landscape media art shaped by real-time environmental data. The description says it converts personal images into photomosaic-based compositions inspired by local landmarks, then adjusts color, lighting, motion, atmosphere and nature-inspired patterns to live conditions such as humidity, wind, wave height, air quality, noise and crowd density.

A modular content pipeline integrates data sensing, visual mapping, regional asset management and display calibration, so it can be deployed across different public spaces without redesigning the whole system, and it uses display metadata, including resolution, aspect ratio, curvature and geometry, to optimize content for flat, curved and circular screens.

ECOVACS was named a 2027 Honoree in Robotics at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for LilMilo, an AI companion robot.

LilMilo is an AI companion robot built to provide responsive, interactive companionship through multimodal perception, expressive movement and natural language interaction. Built on an advanced language model, it integrates visual, auditory and tactile sensing to recognize facial expressions, gestures, voices, sound direction and touch.

It features plush biomimetic fur engineered with millimeter-precision fibers, maintains a comforting 38 degree Celsius body temperature, and uses expressive eyes, articulated head movement and high-fidelity vocal interaction to communicate naturally. The system adapts over time through ongoing learning, memory-based decision-making and emotional cognition, remembering habits and personalizing future interactions.

With five personality types, seven core emotions expressed across multiple intensity levels and more than 40 onboard sensors supported by advanced computing hardware, LilMilo is designed to deliver an evolving, emotionally responsive companionship experience.

55348.x: A factory robot usually stops to swap grippers whenever the job changes, and every pause eats into the day. A hand that trades its own modules and tools mid-motion keeps the line moving.
Emage TomO Pte Ltd was named a 2027 Honoree in Robotics at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the KIASU Hand, an industrial end-effector platform.
The KIASU Hand (Kinematic Interchangeable Auto-swappable Sticky Universal Hand), called kHand, is an industrial end-effector platform engineered for continuous 24/7 high-mix automation.

kHand features vacuum-tip elastomeric "Sticky Fingers" that establish instant surface compliance and localized suction on flat, porous or contoured geometries, letting dedicated digits hold and stabilize workpieces during active processing. Powered by a patented internal Advanced Latch [SP103013US], it provides dual-tier zero-downtime adaptability, automatically interchanging entire hand modules in-flight for major operational shifts and hot-swapping toolable fingers in-flight to deploy process tools on individual digits without stopping robot-arm motion.

Guided by Spatial AI to predict real-time contact points, kHand lets a single robot manipulator grip, stabilize and execute multi-tool process tasks concurrently, eliminating manual retooling, cell redundancies and production downtime.

55349.x: The chips inside an AI data center run hottest in a few dense spots, yet most cooling spreads evenly across the whole surface. Aiming the coolant where the heat actually concentrates squeezes more out of every watt.
Frore Systems was named a 2027 Honoree in Enterprise Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for LiquidJet, a direct-to-chip liquid coldplate.

LiquidJet is a direct-to-chip liquid coldplate for AI data center GPUs and ASICs, manufactured using semiconductor photolithography and etching to create multi-stage 3D short-loop jetchannel microstructures. Borrowed from semiconductor manufacturing and applied to thermal hardware, this approach reaches a level of precision and heat-flux targeting that conventional machined or skived coldplates cannot.

It delivers coolant in a targeted short-loop jetchannel architecture mapped to the GPU's power distribution profile, concentrating cooling where thermal density is highest rather than applying uniform flow across the chip surface.

Validated in independent testing by Foxconn on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPU hardware, LiquidJet keeps GPUs 6 degrees Celsius cooler than reference skived coldplates at significantly lower pressure drop, translating to about 10 percent higher AI tokens per watt, and integrates as a drop-in replacement for existing liquid-cooled infrastructure with no changes to rack architecture or facility systems.

55350.x: For someone who can think clearly but cannot move, the gap between intention and action is total. Reading that intention straight from the brain is what would bridge it.
Gbrain inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Phin Sync, a fully implantable brain-computer interface platform.

Phin Sync is described as a fully implantable brain-computer interface (BCI) platform for individuals with spinal cord injury, ALS, locked-in syndrome and other conditions causing loss of voluntary motor function, meant to help them regain independent control over their environment. A high-spatial-resolution, minimally invasive thin-film cortical electrode covers key regions of the motor network, including the primary motor cortex (M1), dorsal premotor cortex (PMd) and sensory motor cortex (S1), for reliable acquisition of motor-intention electrocorticography (ECoG) signals.

Neural data are transmitted through a skull-mounted wireless interface with biocompatible packaging and thermal management, enabling a leadless, fully implantable architecture, and proprietary signal processing and decoding software converts motor-intention signals into digital control commands.

The description says this lets users interact with computers, assistive technologies, powered wheelchairs, robotic systems and other connected devices, restoring independent environmental control through intuitive brain-driven communication.

55351.x: Reaching into a virtual world is convincing until you try to touch something and feel nothing. A full-arm interface that pushes back makes the digital feel physical.
Haply Robotics Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in XR & Spatial Computing at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for InverseXL, a full-arm haptic interface.

InverseXL is a full-arm haptic interface for interaction with virtual environments, robotic systems and Physical AI workflows, combining precise motion tracking with force feedback across a large workspace that supports natural human arm movement.

It can be used for simulation, industrial training, teleoperation and the collection of human demonstration data for imitation learning and robotic policy development, and interchangeable handles let the same platform support different tools and application-specific interactions.

InverseXL extends Haply's existing haptic technology into a larger working volume while keeping a compact, portable form factor, for engineers, researchers, trainers and robotics developers who need accurate, force-aware interaction across a full arm range of motion.

55352.x: A full eye workup runs through several instruments and 15 or 20 minutes of a technician's time. Folding every one of those functional tests into a two-minute session on a VR headset reshapes the exam.
Heru was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Heru Pretest Pro, software that turns a VR headset into a clinical vision instrument.

Heru Pretest Pro is software that turns any commercial VR headset, such as Pico or Meta Quest, into a Bascom Palmer Eye Institute-validated clinical instrument, delivering every clinically decisive functional vision exam in a single 140-second handsfree session: Visual Acuity, Visual Field, Quantitative Pupil, Quantitative Cover Test and Extraocular Motility. The industry-standard equivalent requires legacy devices, manual work and 15 to 20 minutes of skilled technician time, which Pretest Pro compresses to 140 seconds on one commercial headset.

Visual Field is validated at ICC 0.97 against the Humphrey Field Analyzer running SITA Standard, and the software is FDA-registered (Class I, 510(k) exempt) and updatable over the air, so new tests deploy without new hardware.

It is built on the Heru platform, with more than 1.85 million eyes tested, 25-plus peer-reviewed publications, 75 patents and clinical lineage from Bascom Palmer Eye Institute, the top-ranked ophthalmology hospital in the US.

55353.x: Moving big files between the machines on one desk usually means pushing them out across the building network and back. The data takes the long way around for no good reason.
IntelliConnex Consumer Technologies was named a 2027 Honoree in Computer Peripherals & Accessories at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for RocketBox USB Fabric.

RocketBox is a portable interchange appliance that connects up to five systems over USB. The description says each user installs an app and plugs in a cable, and the workspace is live in seconds, with no IT involvement, addressing or configuration.

The platform creates direct circuits between connected systems at up to 10 Gbps; traffic between systems carries no IP address and never crosses the building network, so the heaviest transfers stay local, and it works with every USB standard since 1996. A shared 10GbE access point gives every attached system a local wired network, replacing a per-system adapter or dock, while three ports deliver 100W of shared power and software updates add capability after purchase.
The enclosure is extruded aluminum and fits in a bag, so the workspace travels with the work.

55354.x: A robot vacuum glides over carpet easily enough, but lifting embedded grit out of the fibers is where most of them give up. Suction alone only reaches so far.
iRobot was named a 2027 Honoree in Home Appliances at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Roomba Max 875 Combo Robot and AutoWash Dock.

Described as iRobot's most advanced robot to date, the 875 is built around proprietary SealForce Vacuuming Technology: rather than relying on suction alone, the chassis lowers a skirt that seals against carpet fibers, concentrating 20 L/s of airflow and 35,000 Pa of suction for what the description calls 3x deeper carpet cleaning.

For hard floors, ultrasonic ThermaMist Technology uses heated mist to loosen dried-on stains, while the self-cleaning PowerSpin Max Roller Mop scrubs at 300 RPM with 18 Newtons of downward pressure for 3.75x deeper scrubbing.
AI-powered, patented DriLift Technology detects carpet and shields rugs from moisture, which the description says delivers a hands-free clean.

55355.x: Helping someone out of a chair and into a wheelchair is one of the hardest, most repeated tasks in daily care, and it wears on backs over time. Supporting the person's own standing motion, rather than hoisting them, changes the strain on both sides.
JATCO was named a 2027 Honoree in Accessibility & Longevity at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Lifmy, a transfer and mobility platform.

Lifmy is a transfer and mobility platform that supports a user's natural standing motion while reducing caregiver workload. Instead of lifting the user mechanically, it coordinates forward-leaning and vertical movement so people can use their remaining physical ability to stand more safely.

After the transfer, the user stays seated on the device and can move directly to the next destination without changing to a wheelchair, cutting handling steps and interruptions in daily care. Developed from JATCO's expertise in motion control and precision engineering, Lifmy combines assisted standing, transfer support and mobility in one system.

Its human-centered approach helps preserve independence, physical function, confidence and dignity while reducing repetitive lifting and strain for professional and family caregivers, applying mobility technology beyond vehicles to support more active movement in aging societies.

55356.x: When an electric-vehicle battery leaves the car, no one can easily tell how much life is left inside it. Guess wrong and a still-useful pack gets scrapped, or a worn one gets reused.
LG Energy Solution Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Vehicle Tech & Advanced Mobility at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Re.Pulse, a second-life battery diagnostic system.

Re.Pulse is LG Energy Solution's battery state-of-health (SoH) diagnostic solution, powered by a pulse-based inspection mechanism whose name, the description says, reflects reviving a battery's pulse. It assesses used battery performance throughout the full lifecycle, whether in service or after removal.

Because the system integrates with standard chargers, the description says it removes the need to take the battery out, making diagnostics faster and simpler, and it delivers cell-level (bank) SoH diagnostics rather than conventional pack-level monitoring. Based on the results, batteries are sorted into three streams, recycling, reuse and remanufacturing, to maximize second-life value.

The description positions it, in an era of EVs and robotics, as a foundational technology that minimizes battery waste and supports a sustainable battery ecosystem, informing practical decisions across diverse second-life applications.

LG Innotek Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Vehicle Tech & Advanced Mobility at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Nexlide C+, a vehicle lighting platform.
Nexlide C+ is LG Innotek's next-generation vehicle lighting platform, creating dynamic graphics and 3D visual effects from a single ultra-slim module.
Its appearance changes with the viewing angle, enabling distinctive brand signatures, enhancing vehicle design and delivering a unique lighting experience.
Its slim, lightweight design also reduces material use, opening new possibilities for the future of mobility.

55358.x: A bank clerk still keys a client's balance sheet in by hand, line by line, and a smudged photocopy only makes it slower. Reading those figures off the page automatically is the shortcut.
Light Momentum Technology Corp. was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for its NVIDIA L40S-powered AI financial statement recognition system.

The system helps bank personnel automatically recognize and process balance sheets and profit-and-loss statements submitted by clients, the description says, aiming to cut manual data-entry time and typing errors while improving image-recognition accuracy. It is positioned against conventional OCR's low recognition rates and precision.

The description reports AI recognition accuracy exceeding 95 percent, reinforcement learning integrated for symbol recognition such as the percent sign, context-aware semantic recognition to overcome broken characters, and enhanced recognition of repeatedly photocopied and faded documents.

It was deployed at Taiwan Business Bank for financial statement recognition and, having passed Proof of Concept and Proof of Service validations, the description says it has gained acceptance for commercial use.

55370.x: Managing diabetes means keeping watch over numbers in the body day after day. Knowing that a change is coming earlier gives people more time to respond.
Abbott was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Libre Duo systems.

Abbott's Libre Duo systems are billed as the world's first dual glucose-ketone sensing biowearables for people with diabetes. The systems continuously monitor both glucose and ketone levels through a single wearable sensor, helping people manage glucose levels for daily diabetes care while also detecting rising ketones before they progress to a diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) emergency.

By reducing reliance on traditional blood or urine ketone tests that provide only a point-in-time measurement, Libre Duo systems deliver earlier awareness and actionable insights when they matter most.

Available in 10-day and 15-day wear options, the systems integrate with Abbott's Libre digital health ecosystem. Users can share glucose and ketone data with caregivers and healthcare providers, and the systems support connectivity with automated insulin delivery systems.

AGC Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Travel & Tourism at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for its Transparent 5G Glass Antenna for High-Speed Rail.
The glass-integrated antenna is designed to support high-speed, high-capacity wireless communication while preserving a vehicle's design and passengers' visibility.
The description says it is already deployed on Japan's Shinkansen high-speed trains, where it supports stable LTE and 5G communication during operation.

By building antenna functionality directly into train windows, the description says it improves onboard connectivity, enhances passenger Wi-Fi services and supports more advanced use of operational data without compromising transparency.

55372.x: Warehouse and factory work involves a lot of lifting, carrying and walking back and forth, and the strain falls on the people doing it. A machine that shares that load has to move safely around the people nearby.
Agility was named a 2027 Honoree in Robotics and Supply & Logistics at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Digit 5.

Digit 5 is a humanoid robot built to work safely and autonomously alongside people. Advanced AI and novel hardware capabilities make this new generation of Digit a versatile solution for complex automation workflows. It has been validated through 65,000 hours of operational time on manufacturing floors, warehouses and distribution centers, and has experience working with 9 customers.
Digit 5 is equipped with physical AI capabilities meant to let it tackle continuously expanding autonomous workflows, while swappable grippers let the robot have the right tool for the job.

Digit lifts heavy loads with a large range of motion to take the strain off human operators. With a superior charge-to-run ratio, Digit 5 is billed as capturing a faster return on customer investment by spending less time at the charge dock and more time on the floor.

55373.x: Phones, laptops and calendars hold much of a person's daily routine. Reaching for a screen to act on it takes time.
Aina Computers, Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Aina Ring.

Aina Ring is an AI interface that knows what users need. Powered by a context-aware OS that silently learns daily patterns across a Mac, phone and calendar, Aina thinks on the user's behalf, predicting the three things they will need next and surfacing the right action on its screen just before they need it.

Booking a cab, joining a meeting, triggering an agent or turning on the lights takes a swipe up, and the task is done. For instance, Aina learns when a user typically leaves for work, so the action to book a cab is already waiting. Aina is billed as the most convenient way to control daily tasks.

For anything unexpected, users hold the center button and talk to the ring. Voice dictation, commands, notes and even phone calls are handled this way, and Aina is billed as the easiest way to control everything.

55374.x: After a border crossing or a disaster, proving who belongs to whom can take longer than people can wait. DNA testing usually happens in a lab, far from where the question is being asked.
ANDE Corporation was named a 2027 Honoree in Products in Support of Human Security for All at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for ANDE Rapid Kinship System.

The ANDE Rapid Kinship System performs DNA identification to enable family relationships to be identified in about 90 minutes. The system works outside the conventional lab and is operable by non-technical users. Consisting of a ruggedized instrument, an AI-based Expert System and a single-use consumable, it is aimed at protecting children by determining familial relationships in immigration and disaster victim identification settings.

The system operates using a microfluidic chip that is factory-preloaded with all reagents. The user inserts cheek swab samples into the chip and places the chip into the instrument. The system conducts hundreds of automated processing steps, and the AI-based software performs kinship analyses to determine the kinship of the sample donors.
It is billed as protecting privacy, because the DNA fingerprint it generates contains no information on the appearance, geographic ancestry or health of the individual.

55375.x: Most security cameras record what happened after someone has already walked up to the house. Stopping a visitor in the moment takes more than a recording.
Anker Innovations was named a 2027 Honoree in Smart Home at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Anker eufy TrackLight Cam S1.

The Anker eufy TrackLight™ Cam S1 is billed as answering what most security cameras cannot: not just what happened, but how to stop it. It combines 180° dual-radar detection, 4K identification and an AI auto-tracking light into one active-deterrence system. Dual radars cover up to 40ft with customizable three-zone control to reduce false triggers.

A 355° pan-tilt mechanism and AI targeting algorithms track intruders, while the adaptive 10° to 30° beam adjusts its focus based on distance, following targets up to 12 meters away. A 105 dB siren adds audible deterrence, while the 4K camera with 10x digital zoom captures distant details.

Radar and Bluetooth recognition also activate soft welcome lighting for family arrivals. A 5.5W solar panel and 15,000 mAh battery support year-round operation. Its minimalist, Red Dot Award-winning design integrates with Apple Home, Google Home and Anker eufy HomeBase S380.

55377.x: People wear earbuds through calls, meetings and loud commutes, and the case they come in usually just holds a charge. What a case could do with those hours is a different question.
Anker Innovations received a 2027 Best of Innovation award in Headphones & Personal Audio at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Anker soundcore Liberty 5 Pro Max.

The Liberty 5 Pro Max is billed as an executive tool built around Anker's custom Thus™ AI Chip, a Compute-in-Memory design delivering 150× the AI compute of its predecessor. It powers three simultaneous pipelines: a 10-sensor array (eight MEMS mics plus two bone-conduction VPUs) that extracts voice in 90dB+ noise, an 8-mic adaptive ANC sampling above 50kHz, and offline whisper-level command recognition audible 10 to 20dB below normal speech.

Its defining feature is a world-first AI Note-Taker in the 1.78-inch AMOLED charging case, the largest in any TWS, which records, transcribes, diarizes and summarizes meetings on-device with one press.

Triple-device multipoint, 5C fast charging (5 minutes for 4 hours) and a bean-shaped form with five ear-tip and three wing sizes round out a flagship that is billed as redefining the charging case as an active control hub.

55378.x: Most sleep gadgets either measure a night or try to improve it. Doing both while keeping a phone out of the bedroom is harder.
Anker Innovations was named a 2027 Honoree in Headphones & Personal Audio at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Anker soundcore Sleep Earbuds 4 Pro.

The Sleep Earbuds 4 Pro are billed as closing the loop that every other sleep device leaves open: they both monitor sleep and actively improve it, entirely phone-free. In-ear PPG sampling at 100 Hz from the vascular-rich ear canal, a positionally stable site that is billed as eliminating the motion artifacts that corrupt wrist and finger readings, fuses heart rate, HRV and respiration into sleep stages and a body-battery score.
That data drives real-time intervention: adaptive audio adjusts its tempo and volume to guide the user back toward rest.

The SleepHub™ smart charging case, billed as the industry's only AMOLED touchscreen case with its own chip and onboard storage, keeps the entire bedtime ritual off the phone and automatically pops up the morning report when the earbuds dock. Thirty-decibel ANC, Twin-Seal isolation and AI snore-masking complete the system.

55379.x: A partner's snoring or a noisy street can keep a couple awake all night. Blocking noise is one thing, and still hearing a smoke alarm is another.
Anker Innovations was named a 2027 Honoree in Headphones & Personal Audio at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Anker soundcore Sleep Earbuds 4.

The Sleep Earbuds 4 are billed as quieting the two noises that keep roughly 20 million US couples awake: ambient sound and a partner's snoring. Enhanced ANC gains 3 to 5 dB in the sleep-critical 200 to 800 Hz band, while Twin-Seal dual-layer ear tips isolate above 2 kHz, the two stages covering complementary frequencies.

For snoring, an industry-first AI adaptive masking system detects each snore's onset, frequency and loudness in the charging case and generates masking audio that follows its rise and fall, something static white noise cannot do.

The Smart Sensing Case™ wakes the user only for critical sounds like a baby's cry or fire alarm, resolving the isolation-versus-vigilance trade-off. A sleep-dedicated cavity mapped from a 10,000+ ear database keeps side sleepers comfortable through the night.

55380.x: Pumping milk tends to happen in the gaps of a day, at a desk, in a car or in the middle of the night. How quiet, comfortable and quick it is matters as much as how well it works.
Anker Innovations was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the eufy Wearable Breast Pump S2 Pro.

The eufy Breast Pump S2 Pro reimagines the wearable pump as a physiological, spa-like system rather than a mechanical vacuum. It is billed as the first to pair HeatFlow 2.0™ 360° warming with VibraPump™ deep-tissue vibration massage and hospital-grade suction in one device: heat dilates milk ducts while vibration clears clogged ducts and stimulates letdown, so mothers can produce more milk in less time.

Its redesigned electro-mechanical platform delivers 46 dB whisper-quiet operation, four app-guided rhythms co-created with lactation consultants, and a 360° see-through flange with a built-in nipple light for easier late-night alignment.
A wireless charging case, billed as a world first, supplies up to seven days of cordless power, and smart sensors stop pumping automatically when the bottle is full.
FDA 510(k)-cleared and BPA-free, the S2 Pro earned an NPS of 76 and commands a 178% category premium.

55381.x: A power cut at night or while no one is home can warm a refrigerator before anyone thinks to plug in a backup. Food and medicine that need to stay cold are what is at stake.
BLUETTI POWER INC was named a 2027 Honoree in Home Appliances and Smart Home at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for BLUETTI FridgePower Ultra-Slim Refrigerator Battery Backup.

Sudden, overnight or unattended outages can interrupt refrigeration before households can retrieve and connect a portable power station, putting food and temperature-sensitive medication at risk. BLUETTI FridgePower takes a fridge-first approach: an ultra-slim, expandable refrigerator battery backup and uninterruptible power supply (UPS) that remains connected for automatic protection. It transfers the refrigerator to battery power within 10 ms, while automatic bypass maintains grid supply when conversion is unnecessary.

Its 2,016Wh LiFePO4 system provides 1,800W continuous output and approximately 21.6 hours of refrigerator backup under BLUETTI's reference load. Scalable with up to three BlueCell 200 expansion batteries, capacity reaches 8,064Wh for approximately four days under the same load.

The 75 mm enclosure supports flat, vertical or wall-mounted installation. Four UPS modes support backup, solar charging and home energy management through the BLUETTI App, with Alexa, Google Home and Home Assistant compatibility. Optional Display 1 provides real-time monitoring.

55382.x: A vet listening to a dog's heart has to pick out a murmur by ear, and what one person hears another may not. A recording that can be shown to the owner makes the finding easier to share.
Boehringer Ingelheim Animal Health was named a 2027 Honoree in Pet & Animal Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for CANINEBEAT® AI.

CANINEBEAT® AI is a proprietary artificial intelligence algorithm that analyzes canine heart sounds to detect, visualize and grade heart murmurs during routine veterinary examinations. The algorithm is delivered through the Eko Vet+™ | CANINEBEAT® AI digital auscultation solution, which combines machine learning with digital acoustic capture and a mobile clinical interface.

Together these three components enable veterinarians to record canine heart sounds, receive real-time AI analysis and communicate findings using audio playback and visuals (phonocardiograms) of heart murmurs, as well as shareable digital reports, including for conversations with the pet owner.
Unlike digital stethoscopes, which only improve sound acquisition, CANINEBEAT® AI interprets those sounds using a fixed dataset trained and validated on more than 4,000 canine heart sound recordings.

Rather than replacing veterinary judgment, the algorithm provides objective, repeatable decision support that is billed as improving cardiac screening and helping identify dogs requiring further diagnostic investigation and potential treatment.

Booster Robotics Technology Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Robotics at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Booster K1 air.

Booster K1 air is a compact humanoid platform built for robotics competitions, research, education and embodied AI development. Standing 95 cm tall and weighing under 13 kg, it delivers agile mobility with 22 degrees of freedom (DoFs), supported by binocular depth vision, a 9-axis IMU and a 6-microphone circular array for walking, obstacle avoidance and dynamic movement.
It supports both no-code teaching and professional algorithm development, backed by an open SDK, ROS2 interfaces and the Booster Agent embodied AI application platform.
Booster Robotics bills it as an ideal solution for laboratory research, classroom instruction and competitive robotics events.

55384.x: Office coffee tends to mean a pot that sits on a burner or a pod machine that fills the bin. People who care about their coffee often go out for a better cup.
BrewBird was named a 2027 Honoree in Food Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for BrewBird Version 3.0 Brewer.

The BrewBird Version 3.0 Brewer is a countertop commercial coffee machine for office kitchens. Each pod contains whole beans that the machine grinds immediately before brewing, then extracts using a pour-over-style method to produce a single cup on demand. Pods are fully compostable, including the filter and grounds.

Coffee is supplied by independent specialty roasters rather than by BrewBird. Roasters partner with BrewBird to have their coffees packed into pods under their own names, and customers select which roasters appear on their machines, typically favoring roasters local to that office. Offerings can be rotated over time.

The brewer is connected, reporting usage, consumption and maintenance status to BrewBird and to the customer's program administrator. BrewBird supplies the hardware, pods and service under a subscription.

55385.x: Steel-framed buildings rely on welded joints between heavy structural members. Those joints are expected to hold up under serious stress.

Chung-Che Chou Lab. (NTU & NCREE, NIAR) was named a 2027 Honoree in Construction & Industrial Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for AI Enhanced Robotic Welding System for Multi-Layer-Multi-Pass CJP Groove Welds.

The system is an autonomous AI-driven robotic complete joint penetration (CJP) welding platform designed for heavy structural steel fabrication. Integrating multi-axis robotics, digital self-adaptive control and 3D laser profilometry, it employs an AI framework to dynamically optimize multi-pass welding parameters.

It autonomously compensates for real-world joint assembly tolerances in steel box columns, producing code-compliant (AWS D1.1:2020, AWS D1.8:2021), seismic-grade complete joint penetration welds verified by non-destructive ultrasonic testing.

Complementing the hardware, a vendor-neutral, cloud-based AI expert platform delivers automated parameter planning and process optimization across heterogeneous robotic manipulators, diverse power sources and multi-brand automated welding systems, ensuring seamless cross-platform interoperability.

55387.x: Divers check a wrist gauge or a console to learn their depth and air, which means looking away from the water in front of them. Keeping that information in view would let them watch what they came to see.

DAÏVE HUD is a full-function Underwater Heads-Up Display (HUD) Dive Computer that transforms compatible framed dive masks into connected underwater computing devices. Its clip-on design lets divers upgrade their preferred mask in seconds without switching to a dedicated smart mask.

The full-color 0.23-inch MIPI OLED provides a 640×400 interface for depth, dive time, NDL, tank pressure, compass, temperature and safety alerts, while underwater messaging enables diver-to-diver communication.

Powered by an ESP32-P4 SoC with camera and display interfaces, DAÏVE is designed as an edge-AI-ready hardware platform for future computer vision, marine-life and environmental recognition, and AI-assisted analysis of dive and sensor data. A replaceable 14500 rechargeable battery provides up to 40 hours of runtime, and the system supports depths up to 120 meters.

Dennisson Technologies was named a 2027 Honoree in Embedded Technologies at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for AuraFlex Photonic Muscle.
AuraFlex™ is billed as the world's first commercially viable light-activated photonic muscle, introducing an entirely new actuation architecture for mechanical systems and robotics.
It consists of only two main component layers, a Light-emitting Layer and a Light-active Muscle Layer.

AuraFlex offers a motion architecture that is billed as simpler, slimmer, lighter and quieter than that of traditional pneumatic and electric motor counterparts, enabling mechanical systems to pack more functionality without adding complexity and bulk.

55389.x: Most people guess at how much water they need, based on thirst or habit. Knowing how hydrated the body actually is would replace the guessing.
Denver Life Sciences was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health and Sports & Fitness at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Aqoir.

Aqoir is an intelligent water bottle that measures systemic hydration non-invasively through a simple finger touch. The bottle's lid contains a multi-wavelength optical sensor array that captures pulse-wave signals, which are analyzed by proprietary machine-learning models to determine a user's hydration status.

Unlike existing hydration products that estimate hydration based on water intake, activity or sweat loss, Aqoir measures the body's physiological response directly. By integrating the sensing technology into an everyday water bottle, Aqoir does not require a wearable or consumable. A companion mobile app syncs with the bottle to display hydration results, trends and insights over time.

Denver Life Sciences has filed seven patents covering its sensing technology and machine-learning methods. Its models have been trained on more than 2 million hydration data points across diverse populations. Independent validation studies are underway with academic and clinical partners.

55394.x: Paying without a screen or keypad is becoming common, in a car, through glasses or at a drive-through. Approving the payment safely in those moments is the harder part.
Crosshub Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in FinTech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for V·Pay, a voiceprint-verified payment solution.

V·Pay lets users approve a specific payment with one verified, transaction-bound phrase. Passkeys confirm account access and voice assistants interpret commands, while V·Pay verifies who is speaking, which registered device is in use, and whether the phrase matches the exact merchant, amount and a one-time nonce.

The technology is a triple voice authorization method aimed at screenless and AI agent-driven payment environments. When a high-risk transaction occurs, such as a payment, high-value transfer, login or account recovery, it verifies the registered device, the speaker's voiceprint and a dynamic one-time authorization phrase at the same time, within 1.2 seconds. Rather than simply recognizing a voice command, it analyzes both the speech content (what was approved) and the frequency, intonation and pronunciation patterns (who approved it). Because the system generates a new phrase for every transaction, recordings, replay attacks and AI-generated voice cloning cannot pass verification.

The voice AI folds speaker verification, anti-spoofing, phrase validation, device trust and transaction risk signals into a single authorization decision. Delivered through mobile SDKs and APIs, it links with existing wallets, payment gateways, merchant apps and AI agents without dedicated authentication hardware. Its risk-adaptive structure requests additional step-up authentication only when it detects anomalies. V·Pay is built for smart glasses, in-car payments, drive-throughs, wearables, kiosks and other settings where screens or manual input are impractical.

55394.cap: Digital student ID ‘Smart ID’ by Crosshub | Photo - Crosshub

55394.x: Crosshub won the Best of Innovation award in the FinTech category at CES 2026 with its Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI)-based identity authentication solution IDBlock and its payment API infrastructure B-Pay. V·Pay is finishing MVP development, and the company is preparing for commercialization through proof-of-concept (PoC) testing in the financial and payment sectors.

Hae-in Jung, Head of North America at Crosshub, said voice assistants on mobile phones specialize in searches and device control, while V·Pay serves as a payment-dedicated authentication layer that verifies not only what was authorized but also who authorized it at the exact moment the payment is processed. She said the company will start with an additional authentication method for high-risk, high-value transactions and expand it into a core authorization tool for screenless payments and AI agent commerce, such as drive-throughs, in-vehicle payments and smart glasses.

Dnsys Innovation was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Dnsys Boostsuit ZX1 KneeHip Sync Exoskeleton.

The DNSYS Boostsuit ZX1 is billed as the world's first modular hip-knee exoskeleton, with 4 joints and 4 synchronized motors that deliver 1,800W of peak power. It is meant to support the full gait of the lower limbs, and users can mix, match or combine hip and knee modules based on their daily scenario.
The hip module weighs 1.6kg and the knee module 1.28kg, for 2.88kg in total. By providing adaptive mechanical assistance, the ZX1 is meant to reduce the overall burden on the lower body.
Targeted users include outdoor enthusiasts pushing physical limits, people seeking an Iron Man-style experience and mobility users regaining daily walking independence.

TITAN 5000 Plus is a mobile whole-home energy storage system that installs without permanent electrical modification.
Paired with EcoFlow's Smart Home Panel 10 (SHP10), it provides whole-home backup power and circuit-level control, with up to 10kW of continuous output.
The system incorporates solar charging and time-of-use energy scheduling, which shifts electricity use to off-peak periods and can reduce a household's payback period to less than three years.

HAL, the Harmoni AI Lieutenant, brings context-aware AI directly to frontline manufacturing workers through the Harmoni device installed at each work center. It knows who the operator is, which machine they are using, what job and part they are producing, which program is running, what engineering and quality requirements apply, plus performance, physical location and relevant history, and dynamically brings together information from work instructions, programs, check sheets, attachments, ERP and MES records, schedules, machine telemetry, alarms, RFID data and historical outcomes.

Operators communicate through multilingual voice, text or an illuminated push-to-talk control. HAL can answer job-specific questions, diagnose problems, calculate performance, predict scrap, recommend process changes, generate schedules and reports, and carry out authorized Harmoni tasks such as creating requests, completing labor transactions, establishing alerts and sending notifications, with every write requiring human confirmation.
HAL is also available through the cloud for engineering, quality, production control and management.

55402.x: Basketball practice often comes down to a ball, a hoop and someone keeping count. Tracking more than makes and misses by hand is hard.
Lumistar (Shanghai) Robotics Technology Co., Ltd. received a 2027 Best of Innovation award in Sports & Fitness at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for CARRY.

CARRY is a portable AI basketball training system that integrates real-time computer vision, motion tracking and interactive training control into a unified practice platform. A multi-camera vision system captures player position, shooting form and ball trajectory during live training sessions. The system continuously analyzes make-and-miss outcomes and shot mechanics to generate structured performance feedback, including shooting accuracy, consistency trends and movement patterns over time.

The companion application functions as a performance dashboard, visualizing shot distribution maps and longitudinal progress metrics so users can identify specific areas for improvement across sessions.

An integrated touchscreen interface lets users select and configure training drills directly on the device. The system also supports real-time multi-user tracking and gesture-based interaction for dynamic training scenarios beyond static shooting drills.

By combining vision-based sensing, data-driven analysis and interactive training control, CARRY is billed as enabling a continuously adaptive and measurable basketball training environment for solo and group practice.

55403.x: Picking skincare or a foundation shade often comes down to guesswork. A good recommendation depends on knowing both the skin and the products.
L'Oréal Groupe was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Beauty Genius.
Beauty Genius is an advanced AI-powered conversational beauty assistant designed to provide instant, expert-level recommendations across web and messaging platforms like WhatsApp.

Powered by four specialized AI engines, including computer vision trained on 150,000+ dermatologist-annotated images, color science matching algorithms, predictive skin analytics and domain-specific generative AI, it processes simultaneous text, voice, image and video inputs in just 0.3 seconds.

The system evaluates skin parameters and facial features in real time, offering hyper-personalized skincare routines, precise shade matching and 24/7 expert guidance across 47 languages and regional dialects. It is billed as outperforming general AI chatbots by 340% in recommendation accuracy.

55404.x: Skin shows its age on the surface, but what drives that aging happens in the cells underneath. Choosing a skincare routine often means guessing at it.
L'Oréal Groupe was named a 2027 Honoree in Beauty Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Cell BioPrint.
Cell BioPrint is an in-store diagnostic service that analyzes key proteins in an individual's skin to evaluate biological aging and longevity status.
It uses a simple, non-invasive tape strip to collect uppermost skin cells, and the system mixes the sample with a specialized buffer before loading it into a microfluidic cartridge.

Developed in collaboration with NanoEntek, it uses ELISA-like immunofluorescence to quantify 9 key biomarkers, including chronic inflammation, cellular senescence and mitochondrial dysfunction, within 30 seconds. Machine learning algorithms cluster results to recommend tailored skincare regimens matched to individual biology.

55405.x: Heart monitoring usually means sticky electrodes and dangling wires that no one wants to wear for long. Weaving the sensors into the fabric itself is how it starts to disappear.
Myant was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Myant SKIIN 2, a medical-grade textile wearable.
The Myant SKIIN 2 is a medical-grade 3D textile wearable that integrates continuous 3-lead ECG, respiration, temperature and motion sensing directly into fabric.
Using proprietary programmable knitting, conductive yarns form dry textile electrodes and an embedded docking interface without adhesive pads or loose wires.

Paired with a low-power, detachable electronics pod and AI-driven analytics, the chest band delivers clinician-ready physiological streaming to support remote patient monitoring, early cardiac-event detection, daily health insights and longitudinal health management from home.

55406.x: Birders usually hear a bird before they see it, then look for it, then try to watch it clearly. A camera that sits fixed and waits for birds to wander into view works differently.
Netvue Technologies Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Pet & Animal Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Birdfy Cam Curator.

Birdfy Cam Curator is billed as reimagining backyard birdwatching around the way birders naturally observe birds: hearing them first, locating them and seeing them clearly. Instead of functioning as a fixed camera that waits for birds to enter the frame, it reconstructs the observation process through an autonomous, AI-powered system.

A three-microphone array first detects and localizes bird activity by sound, while the top-mounted 190° 4K fisheye lens continuously monitors the wider backyard. Once activity is identified, the integrated 4K pan-tilt camera, with 10x optical and 2x digital zoom, turns toward the target to frame and capture birds in close detail.

Rotating solar wings follow sunlight to support long-term, low-maintenance operation. The AI system further identifies species, generates time-lapse views of outdoor space and automatically edits daily highlight clips.
Inspired by garden lighting, its low-disturbance form and stone-like natural finish allow it to blend into backyard environments.

55407.x: A plant's growth depends on temperature, humidity, air and light all at once, and changing one affects the others. Growing or studying crops under exact conditions means controlling all of them.
Percival Scientific was named a 2027 Honoree in Food Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for AR41L3X.

The AR41L3X is a programmable controlled-environment agriculture platform that provides precise control of the physical conditions surrounding crops. The three-tier steel chamber provides 20.4 sq. ft. of growing area with temperature, humidity, oxygen, CO₂, airflow, light intensity, spectrum and light positioning under software control.

Environmental systems provide 40 to 85% RH, 15 to 30°C operation, closed-loop O₂ control to 5% and CO₂ control from 150 to 4,800 ppm, with distributed 330 CFM airflow for boundary-layer and transpiration management.

Four independently dimmable LED channels (450 nm blue, 660 nm red, white and far-red) deliver up to 1,800 µmol/m²/s PPFD. Rail-mounted panels provide two-axis positioning and up to 270° rotation for adjustable solar geometry. Programmable profiles and sequences coordinate environmental and lighting conditions, including solar-light matching.
The cleanable, clinical-white steel chamber is designed for a 20 to 30 year service life and applications ranging from commercial indoor agriculture to specialty crops and agricultural research.

Richten Energy's Coloured Solar Coating enables building façades, curtain walls and other architectural surfaces to generate renewable electricity while preserving their original appearance or customized colors.
Unlike conventional rooftop solar panels, the technology integrates energy generation into the building envelope without compromising architectural design.

The coating is designed for new construction and retrofit projects, offering low-glare performance, UV durability, hydrophobic properties and recyclable materials, which are meant to support sustainable, low-carbon buildings and urban infrastructure.

55409.x: Finding a lipstick shade that feels like your own is harder than it sounds, and plenty of tubes end up unused in a drawer. Mixing a color to order would go straight at that problem.
Shenzhen Metacos Technology Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Beauty Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for DIGICOS Form One.

DIGICOS Form One is billed as a personal desktop lipstick studio that turns inspiration into custom lipsticks. According to the company's research, over 81.5% of users have unused lipsticks due to color mismatch. The device is designed for beauty enthusiasts who explore shades, looks and finishes, and for professional makeup artists and beauty creators.

Users capture a color with a phone or measure a physical sample using DIGICOS Scope, then choose a finish. Form One calculates and dispenses the formula in about 3 minutes, and Vortex mixes it in approximately 2 to 3 minutes. In about 6 minutes, the personalized lipstick is ready to wear.
Every formula can be saved, so users can recreate a favorite color whenever they want.

Shenzhen Neutop Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Content & Entertainment at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Aurzen ZIP Pro Portable Projector.

Aurzen ZIP Pro is billed as the world's first tri-fold Full HD pocket projector, designed to bring a large-screen experience into everyday mobile lifestyles. Building on Aurzen's tri-fold architecture, ZIP Pro integrates a proprietary 10.77 mm ultra-slim optical engine in a pocket-sized form factor.

It delivers native 1080p Full HD resolution with up to 200 ANSI lumens and supports Wi-Fi Direct, USB-C DisplayPort projection, AirPlay, Miracast and Google Cast, enabling content sharing without relying on network connectivity.

TOF autofocus and automatic keystone correction provide instant image setup, while the integrated touch display offers on-device control. A built-in battery provides up to 2.5 hours of entertainment, making ZIP Pro suitable for travel, outdoor activities and everyday portable viewing.

Aeris closely replicates a real-world ultrasound exam, enabling learners to practice the key ultrasound foundations of probe handling, pathology recognition and clinical decision-making in a variety of patient scenarios.

55412.x: Photographing faint objects in the night sky takes long exposures, and the sky keeps moving while the shutter is open. Keeping a camera locked on a target usually takes a lot of setup.
Tinyphoton (Wuhan) Technology Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Imaging at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Draco.

Draco is a portable alt-azimuth system for long-exposure deep-sky imaging. Its 388mm-long, approximately 5.5kg body integrates a 90mm f/3.8 optical system, built-in autoguiding, physical field de-rotation, thermal control, dark-frame calibration and onboard image processing.

During an exposure, the guider measures stellar drift and sends corrections to the tracking system. The main imaging module rotates around the optical axis to counter field rotation produced by alt-azimuth tracking. These functions enable repeatable single-frame exposures up to 300 seconds without polar alignment or an external equatorial mount, wedge or guide scope.

The DWARFLAB app provides target selection, image acquisition, calibration, stacking and processing on a phone or tablet. Its open software layer and built-in coding agent support user-written scripts. PhotonLink allows remote access to a Draco installed at another location, while multiple units can contribute independently captured data to images with longer total integration or wider coverage.

55413.x: A home network has to serve games, video calls and streams at once, and each one notices when another is crowding the line. A network that sorts that out on its own would spare people a lot of resetting.
TP-Link Systems Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Smart Home at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Deco 8 Ultra BN22000 Whole Home Mesh Wi-Fi 8 System.

Deco 8 Ultra (model Deco BN85) is a Wi-Fi 8 mesh system. Wi-Fi 8 StabilityEngine™ is meant to keep performance steady under heavy demand, 25 smart antennas select the best antenna for each device, and Wi-Fi 8 Multi-AP Coordination lets neighboring Deco units coordinate transmissions. Aireal AI technology automatically resolves mesh issues and prioritizes traffic for gaming, streaming and video calls.
Coverage extends up to 9,800 sq. ft., with capacity for 200+ connected devices and up to 22 Gbps of tri-band speed. Every Deco includes four multi-gig ports, two at 10 Gbps and two at 2.5 Gbps.

Users can tap a phone to Deco 8 Ultra to join Wi-Fi with NFC Tap to Connect, and the Deco app guides setup. HomeShield helps protect every connected device, with one year of HomeShield Total Security included at no additional cost. TP-Link bills itself as the world's No. 1 provider of Wi-Fi products.

55419.x: Visual inspection on a factory line requires imaging conditions and inspection criteria matched to each product's shape, material and surface characteristics. Conventional inspection systems are often built for specific products, so equipment and inspection criteria must be adjusted whenever production changes.

A.I.Matics, an AI image recognition company led by CEO Hoon Lee, took a software-based approach to the problem with AIM-T1, an AI vision inspection platform. The company recently announced that AIM-T1 won CES 2027 Innovation Awards in two categories: Artificial Intelligence and Construction & Industrial Tech.

The CES Innovation Awards are presented by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) ahead of CES, the world's largest IT and consumer electronics show, based on an overall evaluation of technology, design and innovation. CES 2027 is scheduled for January 2027 in Las Vegas.

AIM-T1 combines modular hardware with inspection software. When production shifts to a different product, inspection criteria can be updated through software. The platform is designed to generate inspection models for new products using defect-free reference samples. The system combines in-context learning, which enables adaptation using reference examples, with world model technology.

On the hardware side, the optical unit uses a liquid lens and electronic focus stacking. Precise electronic focus control maintains image sharpness across products with different heights and surface characteristics. Field workers can set inspection conditions, check results and improve models through the dedicated software.

A.I.Matics began as an in-house venture at Hyundai Motor Company in 2000 and has since developed expertise in vehicle image recognition technology. Its proprietary AI engine, aimNet, runs in more than 520,000 vehicles. The company adapted that technology, made lightweight for vehicle environments, for manufacturing inspection equipment and unveiled AIM-T1 in April.

"Introducing a new product on a manufacturing line requires considerable time and expense to reconfigure inspection equipment and criteria," Lee said. "AIM-T1 shifts inspection from hardware-dependent systems to software-driven processes, allowing a single machine to handle a wider range of products." He added, "We will use this award to speed up our expansion into overseas markets, including North America."
A.I.Matics plans to present AIM-T1 at CES 2027 and meet manufacturers, automation equipment companies and distribution partners.

55425.x: QUAZAR Co., Ltd. (CEO Myunghyun Kim), a South Korean vision artificial intelligence enterprise, will exhibit at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026, held from November 18 to 20 at Singapore EXPO. The company will showcase its proprietary platform, “QUAZAR Tagless DPP,” recognized as a CES 2027 Innovation Awards Honoree in the Enterprise Tech category. Built to address the European Union’s Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR), the platform delivers end-to-end authentication and lifecycle tracking for consumer goods without requiring physical QR codes, RFID, or NFC tags.

Founded in June 2020 and headquartered in Bupyeong, Incheon, QUAZAR develops advanced computer vision technologies that identify microscopic product characteristics from standard photographic images. Expanding beyond industrial vision, the company has commercialized solutions spanning luxury goods authentication, digital product passports, and AI-driven bird deterrence systems. In 2025, QUAZAR recorded KRW 824 million in revenue and has secured KRW 600 million in cumulative Seed and Pre-A venture funding. Its R&D growth has been backed by national technology initiatives, including South Korea’s TIPS R&D program in 2024, the government startup commercialization program in 2025, Incheon Airport’s startup acceleration project in 2026, and designation as a Global IP Star Company. The enterprise holds four registered patents, has five pending applications, and is an active member of the Korea Intellectual Property Protection Agency’s anti-counterfeiting technology council.

The core highlight presented at SFF 2026, QUAZAR Tagless DPP, introduces a non-invasive identity-capture method that recognizes products directly by their intrinsic physical attributes. The system extracts a unique visual signature from natural manufacturing traces, such as stitching patterns, tooling impressions, and leather or textile grains. Authenticity is validated through a three-stage cross-verification engine combining a vision-language model (VLM), CLIP-Hash visual fingerprint matching, and an algorithmic decision layer modeled on expert appraisal methodologies. An integrated Explainable AI (XAI) module provides transparent rationales for each decision and, in the event of cross-model discrepancies, is backed by human specialist intervention. The platform’s authentication precision ranged from 94.5% to 95.7% in testing certified by the Korea Laboratory Accreditation Scheme (KOLAS).

Verified product records are minted directly on the Polygon Layer-2 blockchain as non-transferable Soulbound Tokens (SBTs), with the underlying evidence securely distributed across the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) to ensure permanent, decentralized data availability. Over a product’s full lifecycle, subsequent events—such as secondary resale, professional repairs, and end-of-life recycling—are appended as linked tokens to the original passport. This architecture enables luxury, fashion, and footwear brands to comply seamlessly with EU ESPR take-back mandates and circularity disclosures via standard APIs and an enterprise console, eliminating the need to construct bespoke IT infrastructure.

55425.x: QUAZAR enters the Singapore exhibition with expanding international business momentum. The company has engaged with global technology platforms, securing selection for the Google Cloud startup program in 2025 and Oracle’s global collaboration cohort in 2026. In the luxury resale sector, QUAZAR executed a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and a letter of intent (LOI) with a United Kingdom-based resale platform, a commercialization NDA with a Canadian partner, and is currently pursuing PCT international patent applications in the United States, the European Union, and Japan. Demonstrating municipal and industrial versatility, QUAZAR also presented its AI solutions at the Smart City Expo World Congress (SCEWC) 2026 in Barcelona, holding consultations with 29 public and corporate entities from 15 countries—including Barcelona City Council, the City of Luxembourg, Enel, and Repsol—which led to joint research discussions with a German research institute and business follow-ups in Saudi Arabia and the United States.

At Singapore EXPO, QUAZAR will demonstrate live end-to-end workflows spanning on-site item authentication, immediate SBT issuance, and mobile verification. The company is actively targeting business meetings with Asian luxury resale marketplaces, regional blockchain ecosystem partners, fintech institutions, and venture investors, aiming to execute three letters of intent and finalize its first paid international pilot deployment. Leveraging Singapore as an operational bridgehead in Asia, QUAZAR plans to establish the market references needed to accelerate enterprise rollouts across the European Union in 2027, helping international fashion exporters meet mandatory European digital product passport requirements.

55435.x: The steady roar that fills an aircraft cabin pours in partly through the windows, and headphones only block it at the ear. Stopping the noise at the glass itself reaches everyone on board.
AGC Inc. received a 2027 Best of Innovation award in Travel & Tourism at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Glass Noise Cancellation (GNC) Module.

AGC's Glass Noise Cancellation (GNC) Module is an aircraft cabin window module that actively reduces noise transmitted through glass. A microphone or sensor detects exterior noise, and an actuator integrated with the glass generates opposite-phase vibrations to reduce sound entering the cabin, achieving noise reduction of up to about 10 dB in demo measurements on a mock-up.

Unlike headphone-based noise cancellation, GNC reduces noise at its transmission path without requiring passengers to wear personal devices, combining AGC's glass engineering and vibration-control expertise to turn glass into an active acoustic component while maintaining visibility and appearance.
Beyond aircraft, AGC envisions extending the technology to other mobility applications, including trains and automobiles, as well as architectural settings such as hotels.

55436.x: Training a robot by trial and error in the real world is slow, costly and hard on the hardware. Letting it practice inside a model of the world instead takes much of that burden off the physical machine.
Agibot was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Genie Envisioner 2.0, an embodied world model system.

Genie Envisioner 2.0 (GE 2.0) is an embodied world model system for robot training and evaluation, comprising the GE-Act world action model and the GE-Sim 2.0 world simulator. Given robot actions, it generates multi-view predictions of future scenes while simultaneously forecasting joint angles and gripper states.

Its built-in World Judge evaluates task outcomes against natural-language instructions and generates reward signals, so robot policies can be evaluated, refined through reinforcement learning and iteratively improved within model-generated environments.
This reduces reliance on physical robots and real-world experimental setups.

55437.x: The batteries in everyday gadgets rely on lithium, nickel and cobalt, metals that are hard to source and harder to dispose of. A cell made from paper that composts at the end of its life is a different proposition.
Flint Labs Pte. Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Energy Transition & Sustainability at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Flint Paper Battery.

Flint's Paper Battery is a rechargeable cellulose-based battery built with no lithium, nickel or cobalt. It delivers 226 Wh/kg energy density, operates across -20 to +60 degrees Celsius, and flexes to a 20mm bend radius for over 1,000 cycles without performance degradation.
It is compostable at the end of life, and is manufactured in Singapore using ambient-temperature, water-based processes.
The battery is available for integration into wearables, asset trackers, smart gadgets and IoT devices.

55438.x: Tinnitus is a ringing in the ears with no outside source, and much of its burden is how much attention it commands. Learning to be less bothered by the sound is often the realistic goal.
Freequency bv. was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Freequency, a smartphone app for people with tinnitus.
Freequency is a smartphone app built to help people with tinnitus become less bothered by it over time, based on two therapeutic principles: exposure therapy and mirror therapy.

Users first match the sound in the app to their own tinnitus. The app then uses augmented reality to represent the sound as a bird inside a cage, placed in the user's own surroundings and viewed through the phone's camera; the user searches for the bird and releases it from its cage, which temporarily stops the sound, after which a new bird appears and the exercise repeats.
By confronting users with their own tinnitus sound through a simple, interactive exercise, Freequency aims to help them feel more comfortable with and more in control of their tinnitus.

55439.x: Most sleep gadgets either just track the night or play the same fixed soundscape regardless of how the night actually goes. Reading the room and the sleeper, then adjusting through the night, is a harder loop to close.
Fullive AI Limited was named a 2027 Honoree in Accessibility & Longevity at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Fullive Somni, a contactless bedside sleep system.

Fullive Somni is a contactless bedside sleep system that uses millimeter-wave and environmental sensing to understand personal sleep patterns and room conditions without a wearable. Its AI continuously refines an individualized sleep model and coordinates sound, light and scent in response to changing sleep states and environmental conditions throughout the night.

Rather than simply tracking sleep or delivering fixed sensory experiences, it creates a closed loop between sensing, personalized interpretation and adaptive multisensory support, and is designed to extend to connected bedroom devices, including temperature control, for broader environmental adaptation over time.

By operating quietly in the background it reduces the need for screens, wearables or repeated interaction, bringing sensing, adaptive intelligence and environmental support together in a single sculptural bedside object.

55441.x: For someone who is blind or losing their sight, getting around has long meant a white cane or a guide dog, each with real limits. A device that steers itself and describes what is ahead offers a third way.
Glidance, Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Accessibility & Longevity and Vehicle Tech & Advanced Mobility at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Glide, a personal mobility device.

Glide is billed as the world's first "intelligent guide," an affordable personal mobility device for people who are blind, have low vision or are experiencing vision loss with age. Built on AI developed from the ground up for navigating unstructured pedestrian environments, it offers the blind and low-vision community a third option alongside the white cane and the guide dog.

With two all-terrain wheels and an adjustable telescoping handle, the user nudges Glide forward and lets it steer, as it physically guides them through familiar and new environments, avoiding obstacles and hazards, describing surroundings and identifying key information along the way.
Quick to learn and intuitive to use, whether for a trip to the local store or a busy airport, Glide is meant to give users the freedom to move independently and confidently on their own terms.

55442.x: Adding a screen to a product has always meant hauling in a driver chip, a controller, firmware and a battery sized for it. Shrinking all that down to something as simple as wiring up an LED opens displays to places they never fit before.
Luchrome was named a 2027 Honoree in Embedded Technologies at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Lunity.

Lunity sets out to turn the display into a simple component rather than a costly subsystem. For 50 years, adding a display meant adding a driver chip, a controller, firmware and a battery built around the screen; Lunity aims to make adding one as simple as connecting an LED, so a product gains the ability to communicate visually without carrying a full display subsystem.
It frames the problem as billions of connected objects still being unable to show the information they already have.

Lunity offers an energy-efficient display simple enough to run straight off any microcontroller, extending visual communication to wearables, packaging, labels and sensors where it was previously impossible.

MediaTek Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Embedded Technologies at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the MediaTek Filogic 8800 Wi-Fi 8 chipset.

Filogic 8800 is billed as the world's first cross-generation-interoperable Wi-Fi 8 chipset, delivering faster, smarter and more reliable Wi-Fi. MediaTek's DSO+ and NPCA+ technologies improve bandwidth utilization and manage interference while maintaining compatibility with legacy Wi-Fi clients.

For everyday users, that means more reliable connectivity and smoother performance when streaming 4K/8K video, gaming, joining video calls, working from home or connecting dozens of smart-home devices at once.

The platform also integrates AI capabilities for network diagnostics, performance optimization and power management, including AI Network Doctor and AI Power Saving, which adapts power consumption to daily usage behaviors.

55446.x: Drawing an accurate floor plan has meant a tape measure, a sketchpad and a lot of corrections back at the desk. Walking the space and watching the plan draw itself removes the redraw.
Moasure was named a 2027 Honoree in Construction & Industrial Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Moasure LX1, a handheld floor-plan measuring device.

Moasure LX1 is a handheld floor-plan measuring device that creates accurate floor plans and building footprints as the user walks through a property and places the device on each wall plane. Connected to the Moasure app via Bluetooth, it combines patented motion-sensor-based measuring technology with an integrated laser to capture room dimensions, wall thicknesses, ceiling heights, doors, windows, staircases and other structural features as measurements are taken.
A complete, dimensioned floor plan is generated live in the app, where users can review, edit, label rooms, add notes and export immediately as a CAD or PDF file, among other formats.

Built to capture complete floor plans from single rooms to complex multi-room properties, LX1 removes the need for manual sketching, tape and laser measures or post-processing, is portable, requires no subscription, and gives professionals a practical way to document indoor spaces.

Morpho Technologies Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Morpho, a desktop UV printer.

Morpho is a desktop UV printer that brings professional-grade tactile fabrication into artists' studios, workshops and classrooms. Built for painters, handcraft artisans, digital creators and custom product makers, it prints vivid colors and raised textures directly onto more than 2,000 surfaces, including wood, metal, acrylic, canvas, glass, leather and ceramics.

Built-in 3D cameras handle automatic object positioning and real-texture scanning, so creators can recreate physical oil-painting strokes, embossed leather goods and custom artwork up to 60 mm tall without physical guides or specialized training.
Its clean, low-odor design turns flat ideas into tangible, sensory creations on the desk.

55448.x: Fitness trackers are good at counting, less good at knowing when a hard day should become an easy one. Pushing a body without reading its limits is how training turns into injury.
Mosscode Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the MossCode PHI Modular Sports Watch.

MossCode PHI is a digital-health wearable that uses training and recovery as the pathway to health, tracking biometrics around the clock and turning those signals into guidance that respects the user's personal baseline.

A screenless Band with an optical sensor stays on the wrist and records heart rate at up to 100 Hz, along with heart-rate variability, sleep, stress and recovery status. A detachable display, the Dial, clicks onto the Band to form a GPS sports watch and recharges the Band while it stays on the wrist, so biomarker tracking never stops.

The MossCode App's AI coach places body biometrics and training data on one platform and sets each day's training target to the user's own baseline, building fitness while limiting the risk of overreaching.

55449.x: A horse cannot say when something feels wrong, and much of what matters to its health shows only in motion, out in the field or on the move. Catching the early signs usually means a trip to the clinic.
Myant received a 2027 Best of Innovation award in Pet & Animal Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for SKIIN Equine, a smart textile platform for equine care.

Worn as a comfortable girth band, SKIIN Equine captures cardiac, respiratory, temperature, biomechanical and behavioral data during normal activity, training, travel and competition, bringing continuous, clinically meaningful physiological monitoring into everyday care.

The system connects owners, trainers and veterinarians through consumer and clinical software, which the description says enables remote assessment, longitudinal tracking and faster identification of potential health risks.
By making advanced monitoring practical outside the clinic, the description says it supports earlier intervention, safer performance decisions and more proactive management of equine health.
